content:
kai: Heads up: planning a config-only deploy at 23:15 UTC. Routing weight change + batch_window reduction for non-SLA tenants. Change window 23:15-23:45. Canary 5% for 10m. @ranjit @maria please standby.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config-only canary id=cfg-2026-03-21-1 target=canary_5% started at 23:15 UTC

maria: Quick checklist: TTL warmup enabled? cache-prefix untouched?

kai: Yes TTL warmup on, cache-prefix unchanged. Patch: routing.weight for tier=free from 0.2 -> 0.1; batch.window_ms 200->150

olivia: Observability: I'll watch per-route p50/p95 and token cost.

deploy-bot: Canary health update — 5m in: 0 errors, p95 +6ms on non-SLA endpoints, CPU +4% on pod pool. Logs: minor kvcache misses ~0.4%.

sam: Those p95 are fine. What about tail latency on long contexts? any spike?

ranjit: Seeing a spike for longcontext-model on geo-eu: p99 up ~120ms; correlates with LRU evictions after batch window shrink. Suggest bump batch.window_ms to 180 for that model.

kai: We can pin routing for longcontext-model to a dedicated group for rollout (pin id longcontext-pin-180). Will that avoid global ripples?

maria: Yes pin for that model + set batch.window_ms override to 180. Also add retryPolicy: backoff small.

olivia: I can patch live: routing pin + override, will run canary 10m

deploy-bot: Patch applied: longcontext-pin-180 created. Canary target updated to: canary_5% + pin(longcontext-model).

sam: Monitoring now: p99 reduced from +120ms to +15ms after pin. No errors. Cost delta negligible.

kai: OK rollforward to full config in 15m unless we see regressions. If p99 > +50ms or errors >0.5% rollback plan: revert routing weight & batch.window_ms to prior.

ranjit: Copying rollback command for ops: `redwoodctl rollback --config cfg-2026-03-21-1 --to-prior` ; notify #incidents if triggered.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll keep watch and tag if anything.

olivia: Release notes draft: "Config-only: reduce non-SLA batch window to 150ms, lower free-tier routing weight to reduce cost; pinned longcontext-model to prevent tail latency regressions; TTL warmup unchanged." 

kai: Nice. Schedule follow-up postmortem if we roll back. Otherwise we ship release notes and close change window at 23:45.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: 10m healthy. No auto-rollback triggered. Next: staged rollout to 25% over 10m.
